say:1:1061203001:1.source_cn: 一、二、三……一个都不少，太好了！

say:2:1061203002:1.text: They're such naughty creatures. You must've had a tough trip getting them back here. Thank you so much.
say:2:1061203002:1.source_cn: 它们都很调皮，带它们回来应该费了不少劲吧，真是麻烦你了。

say:3:1061203003:1.text: Here is a token of my gratitude.
say:3:1061203003:1.source_cn: 这些东西给你，就当是我感谢你的一点心意吧。
